# 生成：DSH-Ops A4 阶段（mock fixture 演示）
# 目标：演示登录页 http://127.0.0.1:8001/api/demo/login/
import re
import pytest
from playwright.sync_api import sync_playwright, expect

USERNAME = "testadmin"
PASSWORD = "admin123456"
LOGIN_URL = "http://127.0.0.1:8001/api/demo/login/"


@pytest.fixture(scope="module")
def browser_page():
    with sync_playwright() as p:
        browser = p.chromium.launch(headless=True, args=["--ignore-certificate-errors"])
        page = browser.new_page()
        yield page
        browser.close()


def test_login_success(browser_page):
    """正常路径：正确凭据登录成功，出现欢迎回来文本。"""
    page = browser_page
    page.goto(LOGIN_URL)
    page.get_by_role("textbox", name="请输入用户名").fill(USERNAME)
    page.get_by_role("textbox", name="请输入密码").fill(PASSWORD)
    page.get_by_role("button", name="登录", exact=True).click()
    expect(page.get_by_text("欢迎回来")).to_be_visible(timeout=5000)


def test_login_blank_username(browser_page):
    """异常路径：用户名为空时登录应被拒绝（页面提示校验）。"""
    page = browser_page
    page.goto(LOGIN_URL)
    page.get_by_role("textbox", name="请输入密码").fill(PASSWORD)
    page.get_by_role("button", name="登录", exact=True).click()
    expect(page.get_by_text("欢迎回来")).to_have_count(0)
